paite: Huan Jobin a gentehna thu a gen nawna, hichiin a chi a:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: Aw nidanglai khate banga om hileng, Pathianin a honveh lai nite bangin;
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

paite: Ka lu tunga a khawnvak a tana, amah vakna a khomiala ka vak lai;
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

paite: Ka hoihlai nitea ka om banga, ka puanin tunga a Pathian thuguk a om laiin;
english: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

paite: Ka kianga Thilbangkimhihthei a om laia, ka kima ka tate a om lai un;
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

paite: Ka kalsuante bawngnawia sawp a hiha, suangpiin sathau luipite a honbut khiaklaiin:
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

paite: Khopia kongpi juana ka pai laiin, kongzinga ka tutna ka bawl laiin,
english: when I went forth to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

paite: Tangvalten a honmu ua, huan a bu ua: huan upate a thou ua a ding uh:
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

paite: Lalte houlim a kidek ua, huan a kam uah a khut uh a koih uh:
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

paite: Miliante aw a daia, huan a lei uh a kam dangtawng uah a belh hi.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

paite: Bilin a honjak laiin, hampha a honchia; huan mitin a honmuh laiin, pom a honchia;
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:

paite: A kap mi genthei, amah panpih ding kuamah neilou, pa bei leng ka suahtaksak jiakin.
english: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had none to help him,

paite: Mangthang dinga mansa vualjawlna ka tungah a hongtunga: huan meithai lungtang kipah jiaka lasa dingin ka omsaka.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

paite: Diktatna ka silha, huan a hontuam hi: ka dikna puannak thupi bang leh suangmantam bang ahi.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

paite: Mittaw adingin mitte ka hi a, khebai adingin khete ka hi.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

paite: Tasam adingin pa ka hia: huan ka theihlouh thubul ka zong khia hi.
english: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn’t know, I searched out.

paite: Diktatlou mi haijek ka hihtana, huan aha akipan a samat ka khahsak.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

paite: Huan ken, Ka bu ah ka si dinga, piaunel bangin ka nite ka pungsak ding, ka chi a:
english: Then I said, ‘I shall die in my own house, I shall number my days as the sand.

paite: Ka zungte tuite phain a dalh jaka, huan ka hiangah jankhuain daitui a kai:
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

paite: Kei ah ka thupina a thak gige a, huan ka khut ah ka thalpeu a thak gige.
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

paite: Miten a honngai ua, a ngak ua, ka thuhilh adingin a dai dide uh.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

paite: Ka thute zohin a pau nawn kei uh; huan ka thugen a tunguah a takkhia.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

paite: Huan vuah ngak bangin a honngak ua; huan vuah nanungte ading bangin lianpiin a kamka uh.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

paite: Kimuanna a neih louh chiangun a tunguah ka nuihmai a; huan ka mel tang a paikhe kei uh.A lampi ding uh ka telsaka, hausa bangin ka tua; sepaihpawl laka kumpipa bangin ka lenga, sunmite lungmuanmi bangin.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

paite: A lampi ding uh ka telsaka, hausa bangin ka tua; sepaihpawl laka kumpipa bangin ka lenga, sunmite lungmuanmi bangin.
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
